description: Masters the song's finished mix: a mix made without a master, an uploaded mix, or again after the genre of an uploaded song changed. The song needs a finished mix, from mix_and_master or an uploaded mix. The studio shows the progress and plays the new master, which replaces an earlier master made in the chat (downloaded ones stay). To master to a reference track (a finished song whose sound the master follows), the person picks the file in the studio under the player, since tools cannot receive files; get_account says whether their plan includes it.

songId.description: The song id from list_songs or create_song.
